reaction_equations: Al2O3 was well understood to be a sequential reaction of TMA and -OH group followed by a reaction of H2O and -CH3 group.
surface_mechanism_description: The ALD reaction of Al2O3 was well understood to be a sequential reaction of TMA and -OH group followed by a reaction of H2O and -CH3 group. One possible explanation of the plasma-oxidized ALD process is that O2 plasma reacts with one methyl group to produce a carbon oxide and Al-O or Al-OH terminated surface which acts as a reaction site for TMA adsorption.
evidence: The ALD reaction of Al2O3 was well understood to be a sequential reaction of TMA and -OH group followed by a reaction of H2O and -CH3 group. Thus, one possible explanation of the plasma-oxidized ALD process is that O2 plasma reacts with one methyl group to produce a carbon oxide and Al-O or Al-OH terminated surface which acts as a reaction site for TMA adsorption.
